is_admin.body: select coalesce((select is_admin and not coalesce(banned, false) from profiles where id = auth.uid()), false);

is_game_member.body: select exists (select 1 from game_players where game_id = g and user_id = auth.uid());

is_group_admin.body: select exists ( select 1 from public.group_members gm where gm.group_id = group_uuid and gm.user_id = user_uuid and gm.status = 'active' and gm.role = 'admin' ) and not coalesce((select banned from profiles where id = user_uuid), false);

is_group_member.body: select exists ( select 1 from public.group_members gm where gm.group_id = group_uuid and gm.user_id = user_uuid and gm.status = 'active' ) and not coalesce((select banned from profiles where id = user_uuid), false);

is_tee_group_marker.body: select exists ( select 1 from game_players w where w.game_id = p_game and w.user_id = auth.uid() and w.is_marker = true and w.tee_group is not null and w.tee_group = p_group );

shares_active_club.body: select exists ( select 1 from group_members me join group_members them on them.group_id = me.group_id where me.user_id = auth.uid() and me.status = 'active' and them.user_id = other and them.status = 'active' );
